name: veil-loom
description: Local-first visual workspace for quantitative research with Pi and Veil

scripts.accept:clean-machine: npm run build && npm run accept:clean-machine:built
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @veilquant/loom-protocol && npm run build --workspace @veilquant/loom-daemon && npm run build --workspace @veilquant/loom-web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev:daemon: npm run build --workspace @veilquant/loom-protocol && npm run dev --workspace @veilquant/loom-daemon
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @veilquant/loom-protocol && npm run dev --workspace @veilquant/loom-web
